web-guide-idea-43.audience: People stuck on a specific spreadsheet or design task.
web-guide-idea-43.offer: Provide guided help with one practical outcome, such as a formula or a clean poster. Let the participant operate the tool so they learn.
web-guide-idea-43.steps.0: Define the exact task and use redacted or sample material.
web-guide-idea-43.steps.1: Demonstrate the key steps, then let the learner repeat them.
web-guide-idea-43.steps.2: Check the result and explain how to reuse the method.
web-guide-idea-43.equipment: A phone for conversation; a laptop is usually best for spreadsheets and detailed design. Use the participant’s existing tool where possible.
web-guide-idea-43.returnReason: Offer another session for a new task or to review work they completed independently.
web-guide-idea-43.promotion: Show a sample outcome and be precise about whether the session covers Excel, Canva or another tool.
web-guide-idea-43.metadataTitle: Excel / Canva Help Desk — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-43.metadataDescription: Guide someone through a spreadsheet, presentation or poster so they learn while making it. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
